messages.subject: Problem deploying shiny .rmd interactive document
parts:
Hello Everyone, 

I recently created shinyapps.io and have deployed a couple shiny apps there. I am now trying to deploy an interactive .rmd file that I created and while it says I have successfully deployed my file, when I try to use the url link, I am directed to the page and it says "NOT FOUND"

I am able to run the shiny interactive document locally from rstudio and have no idea why this is not working on the cloud. 

Can anyone help? Do I need latest versions of R? or anything you can think of?

I have shiny apps embedded in my document, could this be why?

Thank you for any help, I am really desperate

Teresa

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problem deploying shiny .rmd interactive document
parts:
Sorry about your troubles Teresa.  If you have deployed your rmd file to shinyapps.io, you shouldn't need to worry about versions of R.  
Can you send the following information along please?

- The output of shinyapps::showLogs()
- The URL of the deployed RMarkdown doc

I would also try to see if you see the Rmd doc listed in the shinyapps.io dashboard and seeing if clicking on the little arrow will take you to the application properly.  I have seen people have capitalization issues because Windows is forgiving of caps, and unix based operating systems are not.

Hope this helps
